== Summary ==
Text of the 428 messages from Decipher's swccg-discussion mailing list that survive in the Internet Archive's captures of the eGroups / Yahoo! Groups mirror of the list (messages dated 7 January 1997 to 5 December 1998). Each message carries the Wayback URL it was recovered from. E-mail addresses are removed.

Source: [http://www.egroups.com/group/swccg-discussion/ swccg-discussion messages], eGroups. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991010033046/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/ Internet Archive]

See [[Decipher swccg-discussion list archive]].
